output.reason: The changelog line [ev-6c51e98dbb14] and the PR description [ev-795c113bc96d] establish the subject and the change: Traefik's TCP router gains SNI routing for Postgres STARTTLS connections, in both TLS-termination and passthrough modes, as a new capability. Neither says how the feature is activated, though. It could be detected automatically on any TCP entrypoint or require specific TCP router configuration such as a HostSNI rule, so the open applicability condition can't be written from this. The PR's changed files [ev-63b0d50928c7] show that the routing docs (docs/content/routing/routers/index.md) and the TCP router were changed, but neither of those diffs is shown. That documentation, or the router change, is needed to say which environments are exposed and whether existing TCP routing behaviour changes.
